title: pandas: Series, DataFrame, and the index nobody reads

videos.script: NumPy kept the dates in one array and the rain in another. You kept them in step by being careful. {{careful}} pandas keeps them in step for you. A Series is an array with a label on every element. A DataFrame is several of them sharing one set of labels. {{series}} Add two Series and pandas matches the labels before it adds. Labels on one side only become not a number. {{align}} That protects you from the mistake lesson six showed. And it creates a new one. {{new}} The labels travel with the rows, through every filter and every sort. {{travel}} Combine a filtered table with a fresh list of values, and the labels do not match. Every value goes missing, with no error. {{missing}} This lesson reads the trips into a DataFrame, looks at it before believing it, and then reads the column everybody skips. The index. {{end}}
